assignment_algorithm: SHA256(seed || quad_u32_le)[0] & 1 selects ABBA/BAAB independently before launch

per_arm.independent_units: randomized process quad; 64queries within a call are NOT independent timing trials

cpu_scopes: whole OS process user+system incl timeout wrapper
gates.cpu_uncertainty: ratio-of-aggregate on/off quad totals; paired quad residual on-R*off; upper/lower delta-method bounds with 3 * sample SE across32quad residuals / meanoff; approximate Student-based interval, assumptions disclosed
gates.os_time_component_interval: [reported,reported+0.01 seconds); upper on totals use upper endpoint, off lower endpoint; lower bound reverse
gates.latency_observation: each quad: median over64 original ordinals of mean(two on walls)-mean(two off walls), nanoseconds
gates.latency_upper: 24th sorted quad observation (1-based), distribution-free median bound under independent quads; binomial coverage computed beforefreeze
gates.decision: GO only if all six per-arm upper bounds meet thresholds; FAIL if a lower bound exceeds limit; else INCONCLUSIVE
gates.limitations: CPU confidence approximate and depends on independent stable quad errors; randomized orientation spreads position effects but does not control S3 backend; no universal/population/vendor claim

negative_cli: exact config SHA mismatch terminal/stageconfig/zeroqueries/zerocharges/noseal/noGT plus expectedexit2; existing/missing/unrelated output invalidates canary
utc_stamps: before/after every native call outside timed process
semantic_gate: all results equal corresponding immutable historical canonical fields; original ordinals and native recall unchanged; allresults sealed before truth
reviews: db1bd25b59f14b11 both full results reconciled; no new native algorithm change
failure_policy: environment/config/transport INVALID; semantic mismatch invalidates observation; overhead FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE only after complete valid fixed run; no automatic extension
